With its headquarters in Berlin and teams across Munich, Paris, Lisbon, Dubai, and Beirut, simplesurance is driving the global transformation of digital insurance solutions. About the Job As Team Lead Mobile Development, you will lead the engineering team for theAllyz App, reporting directly to the Head of Engineering Product - App Development,Yuri Skliar. This role combines people leadership with hands-on mobile engineering, driving the delivery of high-quality iOS and Android experiences while maintaining a stronger focus on iOS development. You will lead a cross-functional mobile team consisting of 2 iOS Engineers, 2 Android Engineers, and 1 Senior Tester, helping shape the technical direction, engineering standards, and future evolution of our mobile platform. Stay updated with our latest news onLinkedIn. Key Responsibilities * Lead, coach, and develop a mobile team of iOS Engineers, Android Engineers, and a Senior Tester through regular feedback, mentoring, and career development support. * Design, build, and maintain high-quality mobile applications using Swift and Kotlin, with a primary focus on iOS development, ensuring secure, reliable, and performant user experiences. * Own the end-to-end delivery of mobile features, partnering closely with Product, Design, Backend, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver scalable and maintainable solutions. * Drive engineering excellence through architecture best practices, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, performance optimization, accessibility, and technical debt management. * Monitor application performance, stability, and user experience using analytics and observability tools, leveraging insights to continuously improve the Allyz App. Bring to the Team * Proven experience leading and developing software engineering teams in an agile environment. * Strong hands-on mobile development expertise in both Swift and Kotlin, with deeper experience in iOS development and architecture. * Experience building and scaling consumer-facing mobile applications, including full lifecycle delivery from design to production support. * Solid knowledge of mobile architecture patterns, testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering best practices. * Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Design, Backend, QA, and DevOps teams. Even if you don’t check all the boxes, we are happy to receive your CV. What We Offer At simplesurance GmbH, you will get an all-round feel-good package including: * A hybrid environment that fosters flexibility * Working-from-abroad policy of up to 25 days per year * 28 vacation days, plus full paid time off on Christmas New Year’s Eve * Allianz shares guided by our investment policy * Sabbatical leave of up to 2 months after your first year * Learning development opportunities via our Degreed platform * Employee Referral Programme * Regular company events and an open, growth-oriented culture * Choice between a free Deutschland ticket or Internet subsidy * An exceptional company-supported pension plan * JobRad leasing (bike leasing with insurance checkups sponsored) * Centrally located HQ with excellent U-Bahn and S-Bahn access For Your Application No matter your background, we encourage you to apply, andDébora, our Talent Acquisition Manager, is thrilled to review your application.
